title: Gumbo band during the Spanish-American War and the Pickwick and Boston clubs
summary: He joined an ear-playing band at about 27 or 28 around the Spanish-American War, called a gumbo band, and played the Pickwick and Boston clubs and with Charles Hippolyte and Piron.
